featured_reviews.name: Shawn Colaco
featured_reviews.review_text:
I enrolled with genuine interest in learning music, but my experience here was extremely disappointing and a complete waste of money.
The teaching lacks structure and consistency, with little to no personalised attention. You simply attend the sessions, but don’t actually learn much or see any meaningful progress.
The overall approach feels purely commercial, more focused on collecting fees than nurturing students or musical growth. For anyone even mildly serious about music, this setup is frustrating and demotivating.
What’s also concerning is that students are actively encouraged to write reviews, which makes many of the glowing ratings feel forced rather than organic. Based on my experience, the reality does not match the online hype.
I regret enrolling and would not recommend this academy to anyone looking for quality music education.

That alone makes the place feel very welcoming compared to most stores.

They’ve got a really wide variety of instruments and accessories…guitars, keyboards, amps, cables, all neatly displayed and easy to try. It’s a nice place to explore gear, test things out, and just spend time if you’re into music. I did buy a guitar capo and an adapter from there, but they were around 30 to 40% more expensive than what I later found online.

Overall, it’s a great experience-driven store with a friendly vibe and good selection, but probably best to purchase only if you’re okay paying a bit extra for the convenience, in-store support and financially comfortable with it.
